Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a review of the local government whistleblower program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring a review of the local governmentwhistleblower program; and creating new sections.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that there has been noreview of the local government whistleblower act, chapter 42.41 RCW,since its adoption in 1992. By examining a sample of local governmentwhistleblower programs for their effectiveness in fulfilling the policyand intent of the act, the legislature intends to determine whetherchanges to the act are needed or further review is warranted.

The joint legislative audit and reviewcommittee shall review a sample of local government whistleblowerprograms. The committee, in its review, shall consider, but not belimited to, the following factors: The effectiveness of localreporting policies and investigation procedures including the officersresponsible for investigations; the role county prosecutors play inemployee whistleblower investigations; internal conflicts of interestwithin the local government agency that may prevent robustinvestigation of reports of improper governmental action; employee p. 1 SSB 5119awareness of the whistleblower program; employee confidence in programperformance; the effectiveness of the retaliatory action complaintprocess; and the feasibility of providing an independent party toreceive the report of improper governmental action and/or conduct theinvestigation. The committee shall make recommendations regardingimprovements to better facilitate the reporting and investigation ofimproper governmental action in local governments. The committee shallprovide a final report on this review by December 1, 2006.
